Franc (France), Lira (Italy), Drachma (Greece), and Peseta (Spain) were all national currencies of European countries that were replaced by the Euro. The Yen is the current currency of Japan and was not replaced by the Euro.

explanation: All tokens except 'WRITE' can form the name of a common household appliance or machine by adding the suffix '-er' (Toaster, Blender, Washer, Dryer). 'WRITE' forms 'Writer,' which refers to a person, not an appliance.
